An original young woman with wavy, sun-kissed
blonde hair sits on a white couch with her knees
drawn up. She wears a red-and-white striped tank
top with a small bow detail and light wash
straight-leg denim jeans. Red chunky platform
sandals complete the look. Her expression is calm,
looking straight at the camera. Warm, golden
indoor light and a plain beige wall behind her.
